weapons.name: Sword
weapons.blurb: Mid range, mid speed, mid weight. The sword rewards knowing your string better than the other player knows theirs.

weapons.name: Scythe
weapons.blurb: Enormous horizontal reach and hits that drag opponents back to you. Slow enough that a whiff is a free punish for them.

weapons.name: Blasters
weapons.blurb: Fast, light, ranged. Chips from a distance on a six-round magazine and dies earlier than anything else on the roster.

weapons.name: Grimoire
weapons.tagline: Own the ground you stand on
weapons.blurb: Slow, heavy and floaty. Controls space with summons and a chargeable beam, and hits hard enough that one read ends a stock.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.blurb: The slowest, heaviest weapon in the game. It drags on the floor between swings, and every heavy is a lift and a drop rather than a swing.

weapons.name: Warpike
weapons.blurb: The longest reach in the game on the thinnest hitboxes. It thrusts rather than swings, beats every approach, and folds the moment someone is inside it.

weapons.name: Gauntlets
weapons.blurb: The lightest, fastest fighter in the game and the shortest reach in it. Land four hits in a row and Overdrive makes everything faster still.

weapons.name: War Hammer
weapons.blurb: The heaviest, slowest weapon in the game. Every heavy chews through a shield, so blocking it is not the answer it is against everything else.

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.blurb: One arrow at a time, drawn as long as you dare. Helpless up close, and the longest single threat in the game from across the stage.

weapons.name: Chain Flail
weapons.blurb: A weighted head on four studs of chain. Wide, slow arcs that hit going out and coming back, and a snare that decides who closes the distance.

weapons.name: Shield
weapons.blurb: Slow, heavy, and short on reach. Counterguard turns the other player's best move into your best move, and whiffing it is the worst thing you can do.

weapons.name: Dual Daggers
weapons.blurb: The fastest hands and the lightest body in the game. Nine hits in a row is where the damage lives, and a single whiff throws all of it away.

stages.name: Foundry Floor
stages.blurb: Symmetric, hazardless, the standard triangle. The stage that argues with nobody.

stages.name: The Span
stages.blurb: No platforms at all, a high roof and close walls. Every kill here goes out sideways.

stages.name: Smeltworks
stages.blurb: Two islands and a hole between them. Crossing is a decision, not a walk.

stages.name: Rooftops
stages.blurb: Two towers at different heights and a low ceiling. Fights climb, and the top of the map kills.

stages.name: Saltflat
stages.blurb: Long on the left, blocked on the right. The two sides of this stage are not the same game.

stages.name: Undertow
stages.blurb: Drifting platforms over a rising tide. The safe ground moves, and sometimes there is none.

items.name: Blast Keg
items.blurb: Arcs, fuses, and goes off if anyone hits it.

items.name: Rivet Gun
items.blurb: Eight bolts. Chip and interrupt, no kill.

items.name: Bulwark
items.blurb: Carry it and the front is covered. Slows you down.

items.name: Spring Plate
items.blurb: Anyone who lands on it goes straight up.

items.name: Lodestone
items.blurb: Sticks. They fall like a stone for five seconds.
